title: The produceCachedData option of vm.Script is deprecated
summary: Node.js deprecates the produceCachedData option of vm.Script (DEP0110: documentation-only since v10.6.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of the produceCachedData option of vm.Script with script.createCachedData().
